people.name: Mark
people.line: Cousin of Barnabas, companion of Paul, author of Gospel.

people.name: Salamis
people.line: City on Cyprus visited by Paul and Barnabas

translations.web: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.
translations.bsb: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.
translations.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
translations.asv: And when they were at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John as their attendant.
